notes.title: Update notes for March 9th
notes.notes: Fixed the small issue not finding a phone screen at the end of the current script of Kevin's route.

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.notes:
-Added selfies sent by the love interests on their text messages.
- Changed the font color in the phone messages to improve visibility.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
-One of Ivaan's expressions not appearing.
-Sometimes, after the final scene, the game jumped to a previous scene instead of the main menu again.
-Steam Achievements not unlocking (hopefully; I won't be able to test this feature until tomorrow).

Feel free to point me to any remaining bugs you might find, guys!

notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes: A tiny update to fix an issue reported by a player, where the game couldn't find a given position on the screen for an item (tiny, but annoying!)

notes.title: Update fixing images path not found
notes.notes:
Hi,

Some players are finding an annoying error at the start of the game; it's a series of error screens that can be simply ignored, but I'd rather make a new build with those error screens out.

The bug itself will be solved in a few hours. Please, allow us some time to test again what went wrong.

Remember that in games made in renpy you can save your game and then, when a new patch is available, you simply need to either load your saved game, or start anew but playing on "Skip" mode: it will quickly advance until it finds any scene or line you haven't seen yet, so you don't miss a single thing!
